name: Muqarnas
desc: Looking straight up into the crown of a muqarnas vault — tier on tier of faceted stalactite niches honeycombing outward from a slowly turning rosette, each pocket sinking back into shadow as a raking light rakes around the dome and a bloom climbs through the cells.

energy.doc: light contrast + rib weight + chiaroscuro depth

scale.doc: vault size vs frame — 0.5 shows the whole dome down to its rim, 2 climbs into the crown so a few colossal cells fill the frame

density.doc: number of tiers stacked into the vault

fold.doc: rotational symmetry of the vault (cells in the first tier)

pocket.doc: how deep each niche sinks back up into the vault

bloom.doc: strength of the bloom climbing outward through the tiers

style.doc: aesthetic: carved warm stucco / gold leaf on lapis / glazed cobalt-and-turquoise ceramic / cold grey carved stone in chiaroscuro / luminous additive cells on black (non-representational)
